plan_section: §11 G3 anchored validation + §12 frontier gates + §15 stage machine
method: 8 G2 finalists each run the FROZEN validation window ONCE per fold (F2/F3/F4). Validation read exactly once per (config,budget); no re-tune (plan §10.3).

validation_pattern_by_fold.F2_validation_2024: All finalists positive ann (49% to 107%) but DD high (40-62%). This is the same period the F2 train fit was estimated, so the cointegration relation holds.
validation_pattern_by_fold.F3_validation_2025: All finalists near-zero/negative ann (-0.8% to -6.6%). The 2025 crypto bear market breaks the F2-train cointegration relation.
validation_pattern_by_fold.F4_validation_2026YTD: All finalists deeply negative (-35% to -77%). Cointegration does not generalize.

overfitting_diagnosis: The synchronized residual cycle profits on F2 (2024) because the F2-train cointegration fit (2023) continues to hold into 2024. It fails on F3 (2025 bear) and F4 (2026 YTD) because the residual relation is NON-STATIONARY across regime changes — exactly the structural-break risk the plan's anti-overfit contract (§10) is designed to detect. This is an honest empirical result, NOT a code bug.

frontier_gate_check.best_single_fold: M1_085 F2 ann=107.5% but DD=60.6% (far over the DD limit)

conclusion: R8 G3 ANCHORED VALIDATION: 0 finalists survive. The M1 synchronized pair residual Martingale cycle, while a genuine novel mechanism (first time executed natively in 17 rounds, fully bound, produces real loss-after-add SO evidence), does NOT reach any plan §12 frontier gate on the fixed 12-symbol universe across F2/F3/F4 validation. The failure is out-of-sample generalization, not mechanism validity. R9/R10 are not_applicable_zero_survivors (plan §15).
